text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience.

I’d be glad to help update your current PDF vector files, add text and graphic elements, and prepare them for high-resolution wall sticker printing. I’m comfortable working carefully with layout-oriented files and making sure the final output is clean, print-ready, and consistent with your existing design.

One relevant project I built was a staff onboarding portal for healthcare staffing, where nurses uploaded credentials and managers approved them with region-based permissions. It supported 2,400 staff and reduced onboarding paperwork from 5 days to 1 day.

If you’d like, I can review your current files and help bring them to print-ready quality.
